title: Eureka Forbes Ltd - 543482 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Eureka Forbes Q4 FY26 revenue rose 11.6% YoY to INR 684 crore with record 13.2% adjusted EBITDA margin; FY27 margins guided to hold.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 11.6% YoY to INR 684 crore, led by emerging categories and double-digit water purifier growth, with the e-commerce channel disruption from last quarter normalised by quarter-end. Adjusted EBITDA rose 13.1% to INR 90 crore at a 13.2% margin, the company's highest ever, despite intensifying input cost inflation. A calibrated 6-7% price increase was taken in April 2026 to offset West Asia-driven cost and currency pressures. Management guided to holding FY27 margins at least and stepping up revenue growth, while service revenue growth is expected to show up more visibly in FY27 and beyond.

financial_highlights.change: pre-exceptional PAT +19% YoY; reported PAT includes new Wage Code impact taken in Q3 FY26
148% of reported PAT; capex INR 84 crore vs INR 55 crore in FY25
vs net debt of INR 193 crore in June 2022

segments.name: Water purifiers
segments.commentary: Grew double digits in Q4 FY26 after a temporary FY26 moderation following strong FY25; category 3-year CAGR is over 12%, with growth in FY26 attributed to both volume and mix/ASP.

segments.name: Robotics
segments.commentary: Largest emerging category; contributes 65-66% of the vacuum cleaner category, with a target of over INR 1,000 crore by FY30 (management also said INR 1,000 crore in 3-4 years). Now sold through organised and general trade retail; currently imported, shifting to SKD assembly via Dixon partnership.

segments.name: Air purifiers
segments.commentary: Grew 2.7x in FY26 on a low base; Q4 is seasonally lower than Q3 but grew strongly YoY.

segments.name: Water softeners
segments.commentary: Maintained strong double-digit growth; three years of strong growth, with IoT-enabled products in the portfolio.

segments.name: Service and AMC
segments.commentary: AMC bookings grew double digits in FY26, with the fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit booking growth; a higher multi-year AMC mix is building deferred income (liability up about 9% in aggregate). Service revenue growth is expected to step up in FY27 but management did not disclose service revenue separately.

segments.name: Filters
segments.commentary: New simplified filter assortment, new distribution system and consumer education launched; influencer campaign has generated over 1 billion views. Management described this as a multi-year build.

guidance_outlook: FY27 focus is stepping up revenue growth while at least holding margins on a full-year basis; management said margins are not managed quarter by quarter.
Management expects FY27 product business growth in teens and a step-up in service revenue growth versus FY25, with specific numbers to be given in the annual report.
Management stands by FY30 long-term guidance on revenue and EBITDA growth and said FY27 should show acceleration over FY26, barring black swan events.
If input cost inflation sustains at current levels, gross margin headwinds are expected in FY27, to be mitigated through pricing, mix and COGS programmes.
Robotics expected to migrate to Dixon SKD assembly over the next 3-4 months ahead of the BIS QCO deadline in September 2026; localisation to take longer.
capex_capacity: FY26 capex was INR 84 crore, up from INR 55 crore in FY25.
Robotics manufacturing and assembly to migrate from imported finished goods to SKD assembly at Dixon, over the next 3-4 months; full localisation expected to be progressive over the coming quarters.
Service platform technology build (multi-tenant, multi-category) expected to be largely completed in FY27.
Pilots underway for a 4-hour service promise and new service models; service promise moved from 24-hour TAT to a 2-hour slot in FY26.
demand_pricing: Calibrated price increase of 6-7% on average across categories and price points, announced in the last 2-3 days of March and implemented in April 2026; first price increase in nearly four years; management says the increase is landing well with no sellout impact so far.
Competitors have also raised prices; management said not taking a price increase would not be viable.
Price increase is not expected to cause material channel loading; management expects no Q1 FY27 impact from pre-buying.
Management says FY27 growth will come from volume and mix, not pricing alone; monitoring down-trading risk.
Management said market share was not lost to new entrants such as Urban Company, with market share tailwinds exiting FY26.
Management does not expect a drought-like season to materially affect water purifier demand given low penetration and rising health awareness.

qa_highlights.question: Was there channel stocking before the April price hike, and how has April-May trended?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there was some stocking in pockets but no material channel loading; no Q1 FY27 impact expected.

qa_highlights.question: Will service revenue reach double-digit growth from Q1 FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said bookings growth has been double-digit since early FY26, and service revenue growth should step up as the impact plays out through FY27 and FY28; the filter opportunity is the key lever.

qa_highlights.question: How is the company responding to platform disruption in service (e.g. Urban Company)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a 2-hour slot promise (from 24 hours), a 4-hour service promise in pilot, extended warranty and service bundling pilots, and a multi-category service platform.

qa_highlights.question: Can margins be held in FY27 given inflation, and what is the cost impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to hold margins at least on a full-year basis, citing COGS programme scale-up and efficiency; said it is difficult to quantify total cost inflation but the 6-7% price hike largely addresses it, not fully.

qa_highlights.question: What is the water purifier volume vs price split?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a split; said recent growth came from both volume and mix/ASP, and volume growth is expected to become more meaningful.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for AMC liabilities and current vs non-current split?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the shift reflects a higher mix of multi-year AMCs (duration, not volume), with aggregate deferred income liability up about 9%; AMC base not disclosed.

risks_watch: Input cost inflation (polymers, metals, currency) with no end in sight; FY27 gross margin headwinds if inflation persists.
Consumer demand and down-trading risk after the price increase; monitor sellouts and tertiary sales in Q1 FY27.
Competitive disruption in service from platforms such as Urban Company and quick commerce.
Robotics import dependence and the BIS QCO deadline of September 2026; localisation timing.
Service revenue disclosure is not separate; annual report to show FY26 service and product growth.
Filter business is a multi-year behaviour change; revenue impact uncertain near term.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the strategic direction, long-term targets and Q4 margin, but cautious on FY27 macro, cost inflation and the timing of service revenue acceleration. Management was reluctant to quantify cost inflation or disclose service revenue separately, deferring those numbers to the annual report.
key_quotes: In quarter 4, we delivered a strong performance despite a progressively challenging operating environment through the quarter.
we delivered an adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.2%, our highest ever, which is a strong reflection of the inherent strength of our business model.
We look at margins on a full year basis and not necessarily get constrained by a quarter.
we believe that we should be aiming for at least a margin hold.

adds.what: Robotics SKD assembly migration to Dixon partner (replaces imported finished goods; not a company-owned plant)

growth.why: Management guides to stepping up revenue growth in FY27 with product business growth in the teens and at least a held 12.2% margin, backed by a 6-7% April price increase, robotics SKD migration and water purifier recovery, but no specific new capacity or order numbers were given.
